g.text: MIT steering · 5 Hz / ±1 rad / Kp 10, Kd 0.2 · Final 1 s
Positive = logged joint direction (right); A3/F1 independent startup zeros. Red = feedback gap >50 ms.
Torque is current-derived; final CF disabled-mode confirmation failed. Motion feedback only; no invented shutdown hold.
